steps.en: Enable row-based binary logging on the MySQL server
steps.zh: 在 MySQL 服务端开启 ROW 格式 binlog

steps.en: Open a stream as a fake replica
steps.zh: 以伪从库身份开一条流

steps.en: Speaks the replication protocol over PyMySQL and pulls binlog events continuously
steps.zh: 基于 PyMySQL 讲复制协议，持续拉取 binlog

steps.en: Iterate the stream and dispatch per change
steps.zh: 遍历事件流，按变更分派

steps.en: Delivers typed row events with values (before/after on updates)
steps.zh: 交付带值的类型化行事件（更新含前后值）

value.en: Real-time change data capture in a plain Python loop, without Debezium or a Kafka cluster
value.zh: 一个普通 Python 循环就得到实时 CDC，不用架 Debezium 和 Kafka
